major: **Gave the tooltips/context menu, and editor more translations!**
**Overlay Alpha!** Go to settings, then press Overlay, and launch it to try it out! Currently, only Spotify has a module for it.
Plugins now show up as plugins that can be disabled.
You can now activate the 'Hold Activates' Control option on a tile to spam it while you hold it.
User-generated plugin/temporary files are now cleaned on startup, instead of blocking shutdown time
Updated the styling of the Settings page
Stopped event queue blockage upon disconnection
Optimize various functions for slightly faster startup times.
Refactored a lot of render and editor code to be faster, and more generic for future use.
**Dash Pre-alpha!** Go to /dash to see it, it only has a preset layout for now, until it's fully implemented. Overlay is based on most of this code.
other: Removed some minor themes to declutter the theme list
Render types now have better interaction translation keys
